    11  /-!
    12  
    13  # Lemmas about `IsBaseChange` under exact sequences
    14  
    15  In this file, we show that if `S` is a flat `R`-algebra, taking kernels commutes with base change
    16  of modules from `R` to `S`.
    17  
    18  # Main Results
    19  
    20  For `S` an `R`-algebra, consider the following commutative diagram with exact rows,
    21  `M₁` `M₂` `M₃` `R`-modules, `N₁` `N₂` `N₃` `S`-modules,
    22  `R`-linear maps `f₁` `f₂` `i₁` `i₂` `i₃` and `S`-linear maps `g₁` `g₂`.
    23  
    24  M₁ --f₁--> M₂ --f₂--> M₃
    25  |          |          |
    26  i₁         i₂         i₃
    27  |          |          |
    28  v          v          v
    29  N₁ --g₁--> N₂ --g₂--> N₃
    30  
    31  * `IsBaseChange.of_left_exact` : If `S` is flat over `R`, `f₁` and `g₁` are injective,
    32    `i₂` and `i₃` is base change by `S`, then `i₁` is base change by `S`.
    33  
    34  -/
    35  
    36  @[expose] public section
    37  
    38  variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (S : Type*) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    39  
    40  variable {M₁ M₂ M₃ N₁ N₂ N₃ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup M₃]
    41    [AddCommGroup N₁] [AddCommGroup N₂] [AddCommGroup N₃] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃]
    42    [Module R N₁] [Module R N₂] [Module R N₃] [Module S N₁] [Module S N₂] [Module S N₃]
    43    [IsScalarTower R S N₁] [IsScalarTower R S N₂] [IsScalarTower R S N₃]
    44    (h₁ : M₁ →ₗ[R] N₁) (h₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] N₂) (h₃ : M₃ →ₗ[R] N₃)
